item.title: Chargers agree to terms with former Dolphins fullback Alec Ingold on a multiyear contract
item.description: The Los Angeles Chargers agreed to a multiyear deal with fullback Alec Ingold that reunites him with coach Mike McDaniel.

item.title: Rams, Trent McDuffie finishing up extension to make him the highest-paid CB in NFL, AP source says
item.description: Trent McDuffie and the Los Angeles Rams are closing in on a contract extension that will make him the highest-paid cornerback in NFL history.

item.title: Paolo Banchero leads Magic to easy 130-91 win over Bucks as Giannis Antetokounmpo sits
item.description: Paolo Banchero scored 33 points and the Orlando Magic cruised to a 130-91 win over the Milwaukee Bucks, who rested Giannis Antetokounmpo in the second game of a back-to-back.

item.title: Crude oil prices spike above $115 a barrel as the Iran war impedes production and shipping
item.description: Oil prices have briefly spiked near $120 a barrel early Monday as the Iran war disrupted oil production and shipping in the Middle East.

item.title: Wembanyama, Fox fuel dominant performance as Spurs beat Rockets for 4th straight victory, 145-120
item.description: Victor Wembanyama had 29 points, De'Aaron Fox had 20 points and 10 assists and the San Antonio Spurs won their fourth straight, rolling to a 145-120 victory over the Houston Rockets.

item.title: Wheeler-Thomas leads North Dakota State over North Dakota 70-62 in Summit League title game
item.description: Damari Wheeler-Thomas scored 19 points to lead top-seeded North Dakota State to a 70-62 victory over North Dakota, winning the Summit League Championship and earning an automatic berth in the NCAA Tournament for the Bison.

item.title: Raiders acquiring cornerback Taron Johnson in trade with Bills, AP source says
item.description: A person with knowledge of the deal told The Associated Press the Las Vegas Raiders will acquire cornerback Taron Johnson from the Buffalo Bills after the teams agreed to a trade.

item.title: Joel Hofer makes 22 saves for 5th shutout of the season, Blues beat Ducks 4-0
item.description: Joel Hofer made 22 saves for his fifth shutout of the season, Jonathan Drouin scored in his Blues debut and St. Louis beat the Anaheim Ducks 4-0 on Sunday night to sweep a four-game trip.

item.title: Scoot Henderson scores 28 points as the Trail Blazers beat the reeling Pacers 131-111
item.description: Scoot Henderson scored a season-high 28 points on 10-of-15 shooting and the Portland Trail Blazers beat the skidding Indiana Pacers 131-111.

item.title: Westbrook stacks another triple-double in Kings 126-110 win over Bulls
item.description: Russell Westbrook had 23 points, 12 assists and 11 rebounds for his NBA-record 208th career triple-double, and the Sacramento Kings beat the Chicago Bulls 126-110.
